title: WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch
authors_zh: Zimu Lu 等（Multimedia Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong）
paper_type_zh: arXiv 预印本的基准与评测面
best_for_zh: 关注基准、评分契约、污染风险、评测框架和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: WebGen-Bench exposes website generation with browser-executed functional tests as an auditable evaluation surface.
WebGen-Bench 将网站生成与浏览器执行的功能测试做成可审计的评测面。
why: Evaluates building interactive web apps from scratch.
inclusion_reason: Evaluates building interactive web apps from scratch.

title: Problem
问题
html:
WebGen-Bench asks whether language-model code agents can build an interactive, functional, multi-file website from a natural-language request when no starter code is given. The primary source is the arXiv paper "WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch", submitted on 2025-05-06 and revised on 2025-08-11 as arXiv:2505.03733; the official repository and Hugging Face dataset are linked by the authors.

The concrete gap is evaluation: prior repository-level software-engineering benchmarks mostly ask agents to modify or repair existing codebases, while user-facing website builders must choose a stack, create files, implement UI behavior, and satisfy functional and visual requirements from a non-expert instruction. The evaluation surface is a benchmark instance containing one website-generation instruction plus several atomic browser test cases, each with an operation and expected result. Success is not judged by a static answer string; it is decided by a browser-navigation UI agent that executes the test operation on the generated site and returns YES, NO, or PARTIAL, with a separate appearance score for visual quality.

The boundary is important. This work is an evaluation and data-release surface for from-scratch website generation, plus an optional instruction/trajectory resource for supervised fine-tuning. It is not a general theorem prover, not a full-stack production certification suite, and not evidence that a generated website is secure, accessible, legally compliant, or deployment-ready.

WebGen-Bench 想回答的问题很具体：语言模型驱动的代码智能体在没有起始代码的情况下，能不能根据自然语言需求生成可交互、可运行、多文件的网站。主要证据来自 arXiv 论文 "WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch"，初稿提交于 2025-05-06，v2 修订于 2025-08-11；作者同时提供官方 GitHub 仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集。

它补的是评测缺口。SWE-Bench 等仓库级任务主要考察修改或修复既有代码，而网站生成需要智能体自己选择技术栈、组织文件、实现界面行为，并满足非专业用户提出的功能和视觉要求。一个评测实例由网站生成指令和若干浏览器测试用例组成；每个测试用例包含一个用户操作和期望结果。验收不是静态字符串匹配，而是让 WebVoyager 风格的界面智能体在浏览器里执行操作，并输出 YES、NO 或 PARTIAL；视觉质量另由多模态评分器给 1 到 5 分。

边界也要分清：这是一套从零生成网站的可执行评测面，并附带可用于监督微调的数据资源；它不是通用软件认证、不是安全/无障碍/合规测试，也不能证明生成的网站达到生产部署标准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is to turn open-ended website generation into an executable benchmark: natural-language website instructions are paired with operation-level browser tests, and generated websites are scored by running those tests in a UI-agent environment. The core mechanism is a two-part pipeline: curate diverse website instructions from author-created project descriptions, then create and human-refine test cases that cover the instruction requirements while leaving implementation choices open.

The data object is a website-building request together with test cases that specify what to do in the browser and what result should be observed. The feedback contract is YES/NO/PARTIAL from a WebVoyager-style UI agent powered by Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct; weighted accuracy counts YES as 1 and PARTIAL as 0.5. Appearance quality is a separate 1-5 judge signal, not the same as functional test success.

The closest comparisons are repository repair and coding benchmarks such as SWE-Bench, SWE-Bench Multimodal, SWE-Lancer, and code-generation tests, plus automated website usability testing such as UXAgent. The change is the blank-codebase, user-facing website setting with executable browser operations. Direction label: browser-executed evaluation for website-generation agents.

核心贡献可以概括为一句话：把开放式网站生成任务改造成可执行的浏览器评测。它先从作者组织的人类项目描述中整理自然语言网站需求，再为每条需求生成并人工修订覆盖功能和外观要求的测试用例，让被测智能体可以自由实现技术方案，但必须接受浏览器操作验收。

数据对象不是单个答案，而是“网站生成指令 + 多个测试用例 + 被生成的网站代码和运行结果”。测试用例写明要在网页上执行什么操作，以及操作后应该看到什么结果。反馈契约由 WebVoyager 风格界面智能体给出：YES 计 1 分、PARTIAL 计 0.5 分、NO 计 0 分；外观分数是另一个 1 到 5 的多模态判断信号，不能和功能正确率混为一谈。

最接近的参照包括 SWE-Bench、SWE-Bench Multimodal、SWE-Lancer 等仓库修改/修复评测，以及 UXAgent 这类自动网站用户测试。WebGen-Bench 的变化在于从空代码库开始，面向非专业用户的网站需求，并用浏览器操作验证生成结果。方向标签：浏览器执行的网站生成智能体评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs: author-created project descriptions derived from analysis of freelance website-development platforms, functional and appearance requirements brainstormed by forty computer-science Ph.D. students, model-converted website instructions, and generated website code from agents such as Bolt.diy, OpenHands, and Aider.

Pipeline:

  1. The authors summarize 20 web-application categories, create 10,152 project descriptions, convert them into English website-generation instructions, and sample 101 test instructions across three technical categories: content presentation, user interaction, and data management.
  2. For each test instruction, draft test cases are generated, then two Ph.D. students independently review and refine them. The paper reports a final set of 647 test cases, 4-11 per instruction.
  3. Tested agents generate websites. The repository README documents reproduction paths for Bolt.diy, OpenHands, and Aider, with generated outputs and evaluation scripts.
  4. Each test case is transformed into a UI-agent prompt. The browser agent executes the operation, observes screenshots and action trajectories, and returns YES, NO, or PARTIAL. If the interaction limit is reached, a final decision prompt is used.
  5. Accuracy is computed from YES and PARTIAL labels; appearance is graded separately from screenshots on a 1-5 scale.
  6. For WebGen-Instruct, remaining generated instructions are decontaminated against the test set using 5-gram Jaccard similarity greater than 0.6 and sentence-embedding cosine similarity greater than 0.55. The paper reports 6,667 training instructions and a subset of 600 retained Bolt.diy trajectories for supervised fine-tuning after appearance filtering.

Outputs: benchmark instructions, test cases, code/evaluation scripts, generated-site outputs, model weights, and WebGen-Instruct training data. Reproducibility depends on pinning the official data revision, repository commit, browser/runtime setup, agent framework fork, UI-agent model and prompts, model API behavior, timeout policy, dependency versions, and generated-site artifacts. Raw per-row schema fields are not fully verified here because direct raw-file access was unavailable.

输入包括：作者从自由职业网站开发平台归纳出的项目类型、40 名计算机科学博士生头脑风暴出的功能和外观需求、由模型转换得到的网站生成指令，以及 Bolt.diy、OpenHands、Aider 等智能体生成的网站代码。

流程如下：

  1. 作者归纳 20 类 Web 应用，人工创建 10,152 条项目描述，把它们转换成英文网站生成指令，并抽样得到 101 条测试指令，覆盖内容展示、用户交互、数据管理三类技术场景。
  2. 对每条测试指令生成测试用例草稿，再由两名博士生独立审阅和修订。论文正文报告最终有 647 个测试用例，每条指令 4 到 11 个。
  3. 被测智能体生成网站。官方仓库 README 给出 Bolt.diy、OpenHands、Aider 的复现实验路径，并说明包含生成输出和评测脚本。
  4. 每个测试用例被转换成界面智能体的操作提示。浏览器智能体执行操作、观察截图和轨迹，然后输出 YES、NO 或 PARTIAL；达到交互上限时用最终决策提示给出结论。
  5. 功能正确率由 YES/PARTIAL/NO 计算，其中 PARTIAL 计半分；外观质量根据截图另行给 1 到 5 分。
  6. WebGen-Instruct 的训练指令会对测试集做去污染：5-gram Jaccard 相似度高于 0.6 的样本移除，句向量余弦相似度高于 0.55 的样本移除。论文报告得到 6,667 条训练指令，并从其中 2K 条生成 Bolt.diy 轨迹，经外观过滤保留 600 条用于监督微调。

输出物包括测试指令、测试用例、代码和评测脚本、生成网站输出、模型权重和 WebGen-Instruct 训练数据。复现时必须固定数据版本、仓库提交、浏览器和运行时、智能体框架分叉、界面智能体模型和提示、模型 API 行为、超时策略、依赖版本以及生成网站产物。逐行字段名应以实际数据版本为准。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that WebGen-Bench contains 101 website-generation instructions and 647 test cases, while WebGen-Instruct contains 6,667 training instructions. The strongest non-finetuned result in the main table is Bolt.diy with DeepSeek-R1 at 27.8% weighted accuracy; the supervised WebGen-LM-32B model reaches 38.2% after training on 600 filtered trajectories. These numbers support the claim that current agents are far from saturating the benchmark, but they are specific to the tested frameworks, models, prompts, and runtime setup.

Instance-level evidence comes from executed browser test cases: each operation is run on a generated website and the UI agent emits YES, NO, or PARTIAL. The authors compare UI-agent labels with human testing on three Bolt.diy result sets and report alignment rates of 90.3% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, 86.1% for DeepSeek-R1, and 94.4% for DeepSeek-V3. Appearance scores are cross-checked in the appendix with additional multimodal graders and human scores; the ranking among the three inspected systems remains stable.

The evidence boundary is substantial. Functional correctness is only as reliable as the UI agent, browser environment, generated-site startup, and test-case specification. Appearance score is a judge signal, not a proof of usability. The appendix table for test-case categories sums to 667 while the abstract, method section, and HF dataset card report 647, so any downstream count-sensitive analysis should pin the exact dataset revision and recompute counts.

论文报告 WebGen-Bench 有 101 条网站生成指令和 647 个测试用例，WebGen-Instruct 有 6,667 条训练指令。主实验里最强的非微调组合是 Bolt.diy + DeepSeek-R1，加权准确率为 27.8%；用 600 条过滤轨迹监督微调后的 WebGen-LM-32B 达到 38.2%。这些数字说明该评测对当时的智能体仍然较难，但结论只针对论文中的框架、模型、提示和运行环境。

逐实例证据来自浏览器执行：每个测试用例都要求在生成网站上执行一个操作，界面智能体根据观察结果给 YES、NO 或 PARTIAL。作者又人工检查了三个 Bolt.diy 结果集，并报告自动标签与人工测试的对齐率分别为 90.3%、86.1% 和 94.4%。外观分数在附录中用额外多模态评分器和人工分数做了交叉比较，三个被检查系统的相对排序保持一致。

证据边界很明显：功能正确性依赖界面智能体、浏览器环境、网站启动、测试用例写法和超时策略；外观分数只是判断信号，不等价于真实可用性证明。附录的测试类别表合计为 667，而摘要、方法节和 Hugging Face 数据页都写 647；任何依赖精确数量的复用都应固定数据版本并重新统计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior baselines evaluate code agents mostly through coding problems, repository completion, issue resolution, or feature patches on existing projects. WebGen-Bench changes the object: the agent receives a non-expert website request and must produce a runnable multi-file web application from scratch. It also changes the feedback contract from unit tests or issue-resolution labels to browser-executed user operations plus a separate visual-quality judge.

The direction signal is the combination of open-ended generation with executable behavioral tests. The benchmark captures planning, file organization, UI implementation, dynamic behavior, and visual adherence in one environment. The quality signal comes from human-reviewed test cases, a disclosed UI-agent evaluation path, a human-alignment study for the automatic labels, and released code/data/model artifacts.

What is not new: browser automation, UI agents, prompt-based test generation, supervised fine-tuning, and website builders already existed. The reusable contribution is their assembly into a versioned website-generation evaluation surface with public instructions, tests, outputs, and training data. Before reuse, inspect the license, exact split, test-count discrepancy, raw schema, hidden dependency on external model APIs, framework forks, browser/runtime versions, evaluator prompts, timeout policy, and whether public benchmark examples have leaked into later model training.

已有基线多是在代码题、仓库补全、问题修复或已有项目的功能补丁上评测代码智能体。WebGen-Bench 改变的是任务对象：智能体接收非专业用户风格的网站需求，必须从空目录生成可运行的多文件 Web 应用。它也改变了反馈契约：不只看单元测试或问题是否解决，而是用浏览器里的用户操作验收功能，再用独立视觉评分信号评价外观。

方向信号在于把开放生成和可执行行为测试结合起来。这个评测同时触及规划、文件组织、界面实现、动态行为和视觉约束。质量信号来自人工修订的测试用例、公开的界面智能体评测路径、自动标签与人工测试的对齐实验，以及公开代码、数据、模型和生成输出。

不新的部分也要承认：浏览器自动化、界面智能体、提示生成测试、监督微调和网站生成器都不是首次出现。可复用的新意是把这些组件组织成一个有版本数据、可执行测试、公开产物的网站生成评测面。复用前必须检查许可、划分、647/667 数量差异、原始数据字段、外部模型 API 依赖、框架分叉、浏览器和运行时版本、评测提示、超时策略，以及公开测试样本是否进入后续模型训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is relative to the specified browser operation and expected result. A YES label means the UI agent observed behavior matching one test case under the configured environment; it does not certify backend robustness, security, accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, data privacy, or maintainability. PARTIAL labels are especially sensitive to the UI agent's interpretation.

The authors state two explicit limitations: the generated websites are primarily TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, excluding languages such as Python, Java, and Go because of integration complexity; and the training experiment uses supervised fine-tuning rather than reinforcement learning or direct preference optimization. Additional practical limitations include dependency drift, framework forks, generated-site startup failures, browser state, model API changes, screenshots used for appearance grading, and public-test contamination.

The dataset is synthetic and manually curated, which reduces direct copying risk but does not eliminate realism gaps. The MIT license is stated by the paper and HF dataset page, but code and data reuse should still pin the repository commit and dataset revision.

正确性只相对于某个浏览器操作和期望结果成立。YES 表示界面智能体在特定环境下观察到该测试用例被满足；它不证明后端鲁棒性、安全性、无障碍、跨浏览器兼容、隐私或可维护性。PARTIAL 标签尤其依赖界面智能体的解释。

作者明确写了两点限制：生成网站主要使用 TypeScript、JavaScript、CSS 和 HTML，没有覆盖 Python、Java、Go 等语言；训练实验只用了监督微调，没有使用强化学习或直接偏好优化。额外的实践风险包括依赖漂移、框架分叉、生成网站启动失败、浏览器状态、模型 API 变化、截图评分偏差，以及公开测试样本污染后续模型。

数据是合成并人工整理的，这降低了直接复制现有网站的风险，但不消除真实需求差距。论文和 Hugging Face 数据页都声明数据与代码使用 MIT 许可；实际复用仍应固定仓库提交和数据集版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this work as a reference for executable evaluation of website-generation agents. A faithful reuse should preserve instruction text, requirement provenance, test-case operation, expected result, generated code artifact, startup result, UI-agent label, PARTIAL handling, appearance score, framework/model identity, runtime version, timeout, and evaluator prompt.

It is useful as a recipe for turning open-ended UI generation into auditable instances: decompose the user request into atomic browser operations, run them in a controlled environment, record action traces and screenshots, and keep functional success separate from visual preference. It is also useful as a warning that aggregate accuracy is not enough; per-test evidence, startup failures, and evaluator reliability must be retained.

For training use, WebGen-Instruct and the 600 retained trajectories show one supervised fine-tuning path, but training claims require split/decontamination checks and reproduction of the appearance filter. For evaluation use, the public benchmark should be treated as a versioned, potentially contaminable test set rather than a hidden live exam.

这项工作适合用作网站生成智能体的可执行评测范式。复用时应保留指令文本、需求来源、测试操作、期望结果、生成代码产物、启动结果、界面智能体标签、PARTIAL 计分规则、外观分数、框架和模型身份、运行时版本、超时策略和评测提示。

它提供了一个把开放式界面生成变成可审计实例的方法：把用户需求拆成原子浏览器操作，在受控环境中执行，记录轨迹和截图，并把功能成功与视觉偏好分开。它也提醒使用者不要只看聚合准确率；逐测试证据、启动失败和评测器可靠性同样关键。

如果用于训练，WebGen-Instruct 和 600 条过滤轨迹展示的是一条监督微调路线，但训练结论必须复核划分、去污染和外观过滤规则。如果用于评测，公开测试集应被当作有版本、可能被污染的测试资源，而不是隐藏实时考试。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read Section 3 before the result tables: the score only makes sense after the instruction construction, test-case review, UI-agent execution, and appearance grading contracts are clear. Then read Table 3, Table 5, Appendix D, Appendix K, Appendix L, and the repository README.

Keep three labels separate: functional weighted accuracy from YES/PARTIAL/NO, appearance score from screenshots, and training-set usefulness from WebGen-Instruct. A high appearance score does not imply passing functional operations, and a passing operation does not certify the whole site.

For reuse, treat the reported 647 test cases as the main count but keep the Appendix K 667 total as a count discrepancy to resolve against the exact dataset revision.

阅读顺序建议先看第 3 节，再看结果表；只有先弄清指令构造、测试用例修订、界面智能体执行和外观评分契约，分数才有意义。之后重点看表 3、表 5、附录 D、附录 K、附录 L 和官方仓库 README。

必须分开三类标签：YES/PARTIAL/NO 算出的功能正确率、截图得到的外观分数、以及 WebGen-Instruct 对训练的价值。外观高不代表功能操作通过，某个操作通过也不代表整个网站被认证。

复用时以正文和 HF 数据页的 647 个测试用例为主，但要把 Appendix K 的 667 合计视为需要按具体数据版本解决的数量不一致。
